_comment: SRS §5.4 action catalogue: each detector maps to remediation actions with measurable completion criteria; phases are months 0-3 / 3-6 / 6-12; tags must-fix vs strengthens. Mirrors the golden audit's Part 5 structure.

RF-01.title: Adopt and publish an editorial calendar
RF-01.description: Commit to a fixed issues-per-year schedule with per-issue article targets and publish it on the journal site; investigate and document the cause of the historical volume anomaly.
RF-01.completion: Two consecutive issues published within the announced window with article counts inside the announced range.

RF-02.title: Publish a citation-integrity statement and investigate the citation pattern
RF-02.description: Document the cause of the citation surge/collapse (special issues, indexing changes, citation campaigns) and publish a statement; cease any practice that solicits citations.
RF-02.completion: Statement published; the next two OpenAlex year-counts show no engineered surge pattern.

RF-03.title: Adopt a self-citation policy with reviewer screening
RF-03.description: Add a policy capping journal self-citation, instruct reviewers to flag citation padding, and monitor the share quarterly.
RF-03.completion: Journal self-citation share below the rubric threshold in the next audit.

RF-04.title: Publish a board-member submission policy
RF-04.description: Adopt and publish a conflict-of-interest policy for editorial-board submissions: independent handling editor, no same-day acceptance, annual cap per member.
RF-04.completion: Policy public; no same-day board acceptances in the next audit window.

RF-05.title: Audit and correct article date metadata
RF-05.description: Reconcile submitted/accepted/published dates across landing pages, PDFs and deposited metadata; correct impossible orderings and republish.
RF-05.completion: Zero date-order anomalies across the article sample in the next audit.

RF-06.title: Convene an integrity panel for authorship verification
RF-06.description: Constitute a small integrity panel; run an author-verification mailing for the flagged articles; follow the COPE workflow where identity misuse is confirmed, including retraction and a disclosure editorial.
RF-06.completion: Every flagged article resolved: verified, corrected, or retracted per COPE, with outcomes published.

RF-07.title: Adopt similarity screening for all submissions
RF-07.description: Screen every new submission with a similarity tool before review; re-screen the flagged back-catalogue sample; follow the COPE retraction workflow for confirmed copied text and publish a disclosure editorial.
RF-07.completion: Screening active for all new submissions; all flagged candidates resolved with published outcomes.

RF-08.title: Screen reference lists for citation stacking
RF-08.description: Add editorial screening for repeated citation of the same author or venue across unrelated articles; document reviewer guidance.
RF-08.completion: No reference-injection pattern above threshold in the next audit.

RF-10.title: Correct indexing and metric claims
RF-10.description: Remove or precisely qualify every indexing/metric claim that cannot be verified against the index's own master list; link claims to the authoritative source pages.
RF-10.completion: Every indexing claim on the site resolves to a verifiable entry in the named index.

RF-11.title: Withdraw citation-solicitation practices
RF-11.description: Remove announcements or author instructions that require citing the journal; publish a corrective note; add the prohibition to editorial policy.
RF-11.completion: No solicitation language on the site; corrective note published.

RF-12.title: Narrow and specialise the stated scope
RF-12.description: Rewrite the aims-and-scope to the fields the journal demonstrably publishes; align section policies and keywords with the narrowed scope.
RF-12.completion: Published scope names at most the fields represented in the last two volumes.

RF-13.title: Backfill and redeposit article metadata
RF-13.description: Add missing affiliations, normalise author-name casing and Romanisation, and redeposit corrected metadata to Crossref/DOAJ.
RF-13.completion: Metadata-hygiene shares below rubric thresholds in the next audit; redeposits visible in Crossref.

IDENTITY_.title: Correct identity records at the source registries
IDENTITY_.description: File corrections with Crossref, DOAJ and the ISSN Portal so that title, publisher and print/online ISSNs agree everywhere; verify the ISSN-L linkage.
IDENTITY_.completion: All reachable sources agree on title, publisher and ISSN assignment in the next audit.

CRAWL_.title: Reconcile site inventory with OAI-PMH
CRAWL_.description: Fix the mismatch between HTML article listings and the OAI-PMH endpoint (missing records or orphaned pages).
CRAWL_.completion: HTML and OAI article counts agree within tolerance.

EXT_.title: Fix deposited metadata that contradicts the site
EXT_.description: Correct Crossref/OpenAlex records whose titles, author counts or dates disagree with the published pages.
EXT_.completion: Sampled DOI reconciliation shows zero mismatches in the next audit.

G1.title: Publish the peer-review policy
G1.description: Publish a named peer-review model (type, reviewer count, typical turnaround) on a dedicated public page.
G1.completion: Public peer-review page states model, reviewers per paper and turnaround.

G2.title: Regularise the publication schedule
G2.description: Publish and keep an issue schedule; batch accepted articles so issues meet the minimum article count.
G2.completion: Trailing three years show no gap year and issues at or above the minimum size.

G3.title: Resolve ISSN registration and consistency
G3.description: Ensure both print and online ISSNs are registered to this journal and used consistently on the site and in deposited metadata.
G3.completion: ISSN Portal record matches the site and all deposits.

G4.title: Provide English titles and abstracts throughout
G4.description: Add English titles and abstracts for every article, including the back catalogue.
G4.completion: English title and abstract present for every sampled article.

G5.title: Publish the publication-ethics statement
G5.description: Publish a COPE-aligned malpractice and ethics statement on a dedicated public page.
G5.completion: Public ethics page aligned with COPE core practices.

G6.title: Romanise reference lists
G6.description: Require Roman-script references (with transliteration where needed) in author guidelines and enforce at copy-editing.
G6.completion: Roman-script reference share above the rubric bar in the next audit.

standing.title: Enable Crossref reference deposit and DOI hygiene
standing.description: Deposit full reference lists with Crossref and register DOIs for the back catalogue so citation tracking can accrue.
standing.completion: References visible in Crossref for all new issues; back-catalogue DOIs resolve.

standing.title: Internationalise the editorial board
standing.description: Recruit active researchers from outside the dominant country/institution, with verifiable profiles, and publish per-member affiliations.
standing.completion: Board country HHI below the rubric threshold.

standing.title: Commission international thematic issues
standing.description: Invite guest-edited thematic issues with international contributors to raise visibility and citation standing.
standing.completion: At least one thematic issue with majority-international authorship published.

availability.title: Enrol in a preservation network (PKP PN / CLOCKSS)
availability.description: Enable PKP Preservation Network or CLOCKSS so content survives platform failure; declare the arrangement in DOAJ.
availability.completion: Preservation arrangement live and declared in the DOAJ record.

content.title: Require complete author affiliations
content.description: Make institution and country mandatory at submission; backfill missing affiliations in the catalogue.
content.completion: Missing-affiliation share below the rubric threshold.
